summary: Describes OAKLEY, a protocol in which two authenticated parties agree on shared secret keying material using the Diffie-Hellman key exchange as its basic mechanism. It influenced the design of IKE. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Two friends can mix paint colors in public so that both end up with a secret color nobody else can work out. OAKLEY uses that idea to share a secret.
